objective: Improve KG-QA recall and ranking through heavy retrieval and advanced fusion
key_findings: LR reranker with binary features ('in_kg', 'in_text') confirms and strengthens 'KG + text > either alone' result, achieving 70% relative improvement over KG-only.
The 'in_kg' feature has the strongest positive coefficient (+4.61), indicating the model strongly values candidates from the KG walk.
Pseudo-seed fallback combined with binary features partially recovers the unlinked entity slice, improving recall from 0% to 1.7%.
Allowlist expansion (k=8→16) shows minimal impact on recall.
Text retrieval topk increase (20→50) provides no benefit.
reproduction_commands: conda run -n kg-dense python scripts/phase3/text_retrieve_bm25.py --bm25_pkls data/phase2/bm25_U.pkl,data/phase2/bm25_delta.pkl --in_jsonl data/phase3/kgqa_routed_only.jsonl --out_jsonl data/phase3/kgqa_heavy_text.jsonl --topk 50 --force_process_all

conda run -n kg-dense python scripts/phase3/kg_walker.py --graph_triples data/phase2/kg_subset_triples_expanded_v2.jsonl --relation_txt data/raw/kg/wikidata5m/wikidata5m_relation.txt --in_jsonl data/phase3/kgqa_heavy_text.jsonl --out_jsonl data/phase3/kgqa_heavy_text_walked_k16_pseudoseed.jsonl --max_hops 4 --beam 100 --topk 50 --allowlist_k 16
next_phase: Phase 4: Lightweight reader for top-k reranking with cross-encoder or small LLM scorer
